item.title: Scratch Tickets With Your Friends 🎰
item.description:
Title: Scratch Tickets With Your Friends 🎰
Genre: Casual , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Yet Another Publisher
Publisher: Yet Another Publisher
Franchise: Yet Another Publisher
Release Date: Sep 26, 2026




About This Game

A chaotic simulation with fast-paced rounds, ridiculous financial problems, and just enough bad decisions to make everything worse.



Welcome to a tiny utility room next to a recycling factory. Your rent keeps going up, the clock keeps ticking, and your boss has absolutely no sympathy for your financial situation.



Scratch lottery tickets, sort junk, earn money, and upgrade your little operation. Every decision matters when you're trying to stay one step ahead of the next deadline.



When the work is done, there's always somewhere to blow off steam. Explore the club, make questionable choices, earn Prestige, and come back stronger.

Work hard. Scratch harder. Try not to go broke.🎰

🔥 FEATURES


🎰 Lottery Scratch-Offs — Chase wins and keep the money flowing
🗑️ Recycling & Automation — Turn junk into profit and upgrade your setup
⏱️ Fast-Paced Rounds — Every second counts
💰 Upgrades & Perks — Build a more efficient money-making machine
☎️ Absurd Humor — Survive questionable bosses, questionable finances, and even more questionable decisions

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

All final visuals of the game are created and finalized by our art team. AI-assisted tools are used only during the early concept and ideation stages. All visual assets in the final version are manually created, refined, and finalized by our artists.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 or above
    • Processor: Intel or AMD
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Direct X compatible
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS
    • Processor: Apple M1 або Intel Core M
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Direct X compatible
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
* Starting February 15, 2024, the Steam Client will no longer support 32-bit games or macOS 10.14 or lower.

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: Linux
    • Processor: Intel or AMD
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Direct X compatible
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Stranded with You
item.description:
Title: Stranded with You
Genre: Adventure , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Kumada Gaon
Publisher: Saikey Studios
Release Date: Sep 25, 2026




About This Game

You open your eyes and… find yourself on a desert island?!

You and your childhood friend, Mitsuki Nanami, had not kept in contact for many years. But one day, she invited you on a trip for summer vacation. While on the trip, your ship was caught in a great storm, and the two of you ended up stranded on a desert island.

Now you must explore, secure food and water, forage for supplies, and craft items in order to survive and escape the island. And through these shared hardships, your relationship with Mitsuki may begin to change.

Do all you can to survive on a desert island. Explore, create a shelter, search for supplies, fish, hunt, cut wood, mine, and much more. Train your stats and craft tools to increase your chances of success, discover new crafting recipes, and make your shelter feel a little more like home each day. But be careful not to overexert yourself, physically or mentally. This isn’t only your survival story, and Mitsuki is always there to help you.

Once you are ready, you can create a boat and attempt to escape the island. The journey will be difficult, but failure can open the door to new innovations.

Acquire Materials and Craft

In order to ensure your survival, you will need to acquire materials by exploring and completing various tasks. You can use these materials to craft new items and tools that will help you survive.

Increase Stats and Deepen your Bond

Increase your stats through training, and deepen your bond with Mitsuki through various actions at the shelter. Remember, you are not alone. Nanami’s assistance will be crucial.

Escape the Island

Survival isn’t the end goal; returning home is. Make a boat and attempt the gruelling journey back to civilization.

Recollection Room

View your special moments with Mitsuki at any time after unlocking them.

    • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
    • Storage: 1 GB available space

    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: Lucid Cats
item.description:
Title: Lucid Cats
Genre: Action , Strategy
Developer: Kolide Studio
Publisher: Kolide Studio
Release Date: Sep 25, 2026




About This Game

Lucid Cats is an online co-op horror game for up to four players featuring creepy monsters, liminal procedurally generated dream levels, and proximity voice chat.

🐾 Play with friends: Lucid Cats uses invite-only lobbies. Host a game and invite up to three friends through Steam. There is currently no public matchmaking. Solo play is also supported.

  • FALL ASLEEP

    Wake together in a shared dream: weird, nostalgic, and full of valuables to take.

  • LOOT THE DREAM

    Valuables are instantly credited to you. However, you can only keep them if you find the dream exit and meet the quota.

  • PROCEDURAL LEVELS + SECURITY CAMERAS

    A weirdcore, dreamcore descent into places that are nostalgic, unsettling, and laid out differently every time.

  • LAPTOP UPGRADES

    Security cameras, valuable trackers, and more: your Laptop is your best friend for navigating the dream world and succeeding with your friends.

  • FIND THE EXIT

    Use proximity voice chat to guide each other and stay immersed. Find the exit to keep your haul. If you die in the dream, you wake with nothing.

item.title: I Know a Guy: Shady Life Simulator
item.description:
Title: I Know a Guy: Shady Life Simulator
Genre: Simulation
Developer: Bunch'o'Nerds
Publisher: Bunch'o'Nerds
Release Date: Sep 25, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Apr 1, 2026




About This Game

You owe a dangerous, mysterious mafia a serious amount of money. They don’t call. They don’t warn you. They kidnap you and make it clear: work it off, or else. Run your pizza shop, take on shady favors, and get to know the people of Hobarey Town while doing the mafia’s dirty work. Learn who to trust, who to use, and who to avoid.

Maybe you’ll pay off your debt. Maybe you’ll build the right connections to start a new life.

EXPERIENCE DUAL-LIFE

Manage a pizza shop up front while running illegal jobs out back. Keep both sides operating without drawing police attention or blowing your cover.

TAKE SHADY JOBS

Complete illegal favors for NPCs, including cleaning bloody clothes, ordering restricted items from the dark web, disposing of evidence, and even burning bodies in your own oven. Every job increases payout, risk, and police attention.

BUILD YOUR REPUTATION

Build a strong cover by becoming the best pizza shop in town while separately earning trust in the shady underworld. Each side progresses on its own, unlocking different jobs, tools, and risks.

UPGRADE YOUR OPERATION

Upgrade your kitchen, hidden workstations, and equipment. Larger setups allow faster production, riskier jobs, and higher payouts.

DEAL WITH WEIRD NPCs

Interact with dozens of hand-crafted NPCs, each with their own stories, personalities, and ongoing problems that unfold over time.

PLAY TOGETHER

Play alone or team up with up to four players online. Split tasks, run both sides of the business together, and deal with the chaos as a group. Both offline and co-op mode updated with 1.0.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game features narrative-driven illegal activities and illicit trade operations. It includes in-game missions and items related to drug and alcohol use. Additionally, players can interact with adult-themed items, including trading weapons and sex toys, as part of the gameplay experience.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5-8400
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX580
    • Storage: 6 GB available space
    • Sound Card: -
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
    • Storage: 6 GB available space
    • Sound Card: -

item.title: Scapewatch: Idle MMO
item.description:
Title: Scapewatch: Idle MMO
Genre: Indie , Massively Multiplayer , RPG
Developer: Puzzle Drop Studios
Publisher: Puzzle Drop Studios
Release Date: Sep 25, 2026




About This Game

Scapewatch: Idle MMO

Explore a hand-crafted online world, master combat across melee, ranged, and magic, join clans, chase pets, climb leaderboards, conquer raids, and show off the grind with skill capes and rare rewards.

Train 30 skills, queue your next task, close the tab, and come back stronger. Your character keeps working while you’re offline, gathering resources, fighting enemies, progressing skills, filling your bank, and pushing toward the next milestone.

Master 30 Unique Skills

Train all skills as you build toward max total level and unlock some of the game’s biggest rewards.

Combat: Life, Spirit, Strike, Heft, Sight, Draw, Focus, Surge, Dodge, Defend

Gathering: Fish, Mine, Forage, Invoke, Farm, Plunder, Bard

Processing: Cook, Smith, Craft, Imbue, Brew, Barter, Discover

Field: Vigor, Slay, Luck, Alms

Raids: Delve and Fortify

Control Your Adventures

You can manipulate which locations you travel to, skills you train, & enemies you fight with an AWESOME amount of strategy available to the player.

Favor certain skills. Weight specific activities. Reroll tasks you don’t want. Shape the grind around your goals. Whether you’re chasing a cape, farming a resource, hunting drops, or pushing leaderboards, your setup is everything!


COMPLETE QUESTS FOR BIG REWARDS REROLL TASKS & EXPLORE YOUR WAY!

Control Your Adventures

Fight using melee, ranged, or magic, each with its own progression path.

Social Features & Raiding!

Create a clan, chat with friends, compare progress, and see live broadcasts when clanmates level up, complete quests, find pets, or die in combat.

Take on raids with up to 5 players across five difficulty tiers. Clear waves of randomized enemies, revive between waves, earn loot based on contribution, and climb the clan leaderboards.

Complete Treasure Scrolls, Find Pets, Push Leaderboards & Complete Collection Logs!

Scapewatch is built around long-term goals and visible achievements.

30 skills to train
60 skill pets, plus shiny variants
62 skill capes, including trimmed variants
Treasure scrolls and tiered loot chests
Quests across the world
Hiscores for skills, pets, scrolls, clans, and more
XP milestones

Truly Idle. Truly Online.

Scapewatch keeps going when you log off.

Your queue continues. Your bank grows. Your skills progress. Your next task begins.

When you return, you’ll see what your character accomplished while you were away — then tune your next grind and keep pushing.

Other players are online too. You’ll see them moving through the world, walking with pets, showing off capes, chatting, joining clans, and competing on hiscores.

Join the Playtest

Scapewatch is currently in playtest.

Request access to start playing, and wishlist the game to get notified when it launches.

Online connection required.
